meaning:
σπιλόω
[in LXX: Wis.15:4 * ;]
to stain, spot, defile: with accusative, Jas.3:6, Ju 23.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is…
and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.
